goal: A thesis author can run shared offline core services and safely rebuild a DOCX without losing the previous valid output.
non_goals: Do not expand the complete thesis example or broad Office acceptance before task 008.
Do not implement packaging and final maintenance documentation before task 009.
Do not require byte-for-byte identical DOCX archives.
Do not add watch mode, background work, UI, account, cloud or AI behavior.
Do not move content rendering, package validation or atomic replacement into Core Domain.
expected_evidence: Observed RED and GREEN shared application service tests
Progress order parse, validate, compile, render and finalize
Fatal validation proves Compiler and Renderer are not invoked
Parse, validation, compiler, renderer, package and replacement failure tests preserve old output bytes
Every failure test proves same-directory temporary output cleanup
DOCX package validator rejects corrupt ZIP, missing required parts and malformed core XML
CLI output identifies the exact failing stage without traceback
Repeated builds have normalized numbering, bookmark, reference and field semantic equivalence
Architecture tests prove CLI delegates and lower layers do not import adapters
Full pytest, Ruff and pip check output
Offline inspect, validate and build command evidence
DOCX ZIP/XML inspection, python-docx reload and LibreOffice conversion
Task report, independent spec review and independent quality review
unsafe_assumptions: A successful renderer save is not package validation.
Cross-directory temporary output is not guaranteed to replace atomically.
Preserving the target is insufficient if temporary files leak.
DOCX archive bytes may differ while required semantic OOXML remains equivalent.
A presentation adapter must not duplicate parse, validation, compile or render orchestration.
stop_condition: Stop if implementation edits outside the allowlist, crosses Core or Renderer boundaries, can damage an existing output on failure, leaks temporary files, accepts an invalid DOCX package, or requires task-008 acceptance scope.
